seo.title: Picnic Club · Luxury picnics, proposals and elopements in Portugal
seo.description: Slow luxury experiences, beautifully curated in Portugal: luxury picnics, marriage proposals, elopement weddings and private celebrations in Comporta, Tróia, Melides and Lisbon.

hero.title: Moments worth keeping.
hero.text: Slow luxury experiences, beautifully curated in Portugal.

intro.title: Beautifully curated moments, made effortless.
text: PICNIC CLUB creates unforgettable experiences in some of Portugal’s most beautiful places.
From intimate marriage proposals and elopement weddings to private picnics and celebrations, every detail is thoughtfully curated so you can simply be present in the moment.

experiences.title: A taste of what we create
experiences.text: Four ways to celebrate by the sea, each one designed around the setting and the people you love.

philosophy.title: We’ll handle the rest.
lines: We believe luxury is not about excess.
philosophy.text: Every PICNIC CLUB experience is thoughtfully designed so that you don’t have to worry about the details. You simply arrive, and enjoy the moment.

elopement.title: Your wedding. Your way.
text: Elopement weddings are intimate celebrations designed around what truly matters.
A beautiful place. The person you love. Your closest people. And a day that feels entirely yours.

locations.title: Beautiful places. Unforgettable settings.
locations.text: From the rice fields and dunes of Comporta to the long beaches of Tróia and Melides, and the light of Lisbon.

final.title: Let’s create something beautiful.
text: Planning a proposal, an intimate wedding or a celebration in Portugal?
Tell us what you’re imagining. We’ll take care of the rest.
